statements.note: The abstract reports that AGO4 and AGO6 preferentially load 24A siRNAs but use distinct mechanisms to do so.

statements.text: Coordination between the MID and PIWI domains, rather than the known nucleotide specificity loop of the MID domain, sets the 5' A preference of AGO4 and AGO6.

statements.note: The abstract attributes the 5' A specificity to coordination of the MID and PIWI domains rather than to the MID-domain nucleotide specificity loop.

statements.label: supported
